principles.title: Separate people from the problem
principles.description: Focus on the issue, not personal attacks

techniques.title: Mirroring
techniques.description: Repeat the last 3 words to encourage elaboration
techniques.example: Them: 'The price is too high.' You: 'Too high?'

techniques.title: Labeling emotions
techniques.example: It seems like you're concerned about the timeline

techniques.title: Calibrated questions
techniques.description: Ask 'how' and 'what' questions to give control
examples: How am I supposed to do that?
What about this doesn't work for you?
How can we solve this together?

techniques.title: Tactical empathy
techniques.example: I understand this is a significant investment for you

techniques.title: No-oriented questions
techniques.description: Make it easy to say no to feel in control
techniques.example: Is now a bad time to talk?

manipulation.name: False urgency
manipulation.counter: Expose the tactic politely and ignore the urgency
manipulation.response_template: I appreciate the offer, but I need time to make the right decision. If this expires, I'm comfortable with that.
manipulation.auto_pilot_script: Je comprends votre position sur les délais, mais je préfère prendre le temps nécessaire pour une décision réfléchie.

manipulation.name: Aggressive anchoring
manipulation.counter: Ignore the anchor completely, set your own
manipulation.response_template: Let me share what makes sense from our perspective...
manipulation.auto_pilot_script: Laissez-moi vous expliquer notre vision de la valeur pour ce projet.

manipulation.name: Good cop / Bad cop
manipulation.response_template: I'd prefer to speak directly with the decision maker.
manipulation.auto_pilot_script: Je pense qu'il serait plus efficace de discuter directement avec la personne qui a l'autorité finale.

manipulation.name: Nibbling
manipulation.response_template: If we're reopening terms, I have additional items to discuss as well.
manipulation.auto_pilot_script: Si nous modifions l'accord, je souhaiterais également revoir certains points de notre côté.

counters.template: Let me break down the ROI...
questions: What's the cost of not solving this problem?
How much time/money does this save you?

counters.template: Compared to alternatives, here's our unique value...
What if we start with the core package?

counters.question: Who else needs to be involved in this decision?

counters.template: If you had the authority, would this work for you?
How can I help you present this to your team?
Let's compare total cost over 12 months including support, training...
What's the cost of choosing the wrong solution?

opportunities.response_template: It sounds like you're interested but have some reservations. What would make you feel confident moving forward?
opportunities.auto_pilot_script: Je sens que cela vous intéresse. Qu'est-ce qui vous aiderait à prendre une décision sereine?

opportunities.response_template: Great, let's ensure we maximize that budget for the best outcome.
That sounds frustrating. How long has this been impacting your operations?

stalemate.auto_pilot_script: Je remarque que nous tournons en rond. Explorons une nouvelle approche ensemble.
Récapitulons ce sur quoi nous sommes d'accord et identifions le point de blocage principal.

closing_techniques.name: Assumptive close
closing_techniques.description: Act as if agreement is reached
closing_techniques.example: When should we schedule the kickoff meeting?

closing_techniques.name: Alternative choice close
closing_techniques.example: Would you prefer the monthly or annual plan?

closing_techniques.name: Summary close
closing_techniques.description: Recap benefits and ask for commitment
closing_techniques.example: So we've agreed on X, Y, Z. Shall we move forward?
closing_techniques.when_to_use: After long negotiation to crystalize agreement

closing_techniques.name: Legitimate urgency
closing_techniques.example: The price increases next quarter due to new features

closing_techniques.name: Trial close
closing_techniques.example: If we could solve the integration concern, would you be ready?

power_phrases: Help me understand your thinking here...
What would make this a win for both of us?
How do you see this working ideally?
From your perspective, what's most important?
